content: Akar-akar-isgulesad-anar ibmar-ukleged

Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Ar dule-gwensakse gorlenonikile, be ibmar-daksad, be ibmar-itosad sogdaye. Ar we-dule yapa sogdagele, we-dule, dummad-nosad, degisoggu, sabsur-odurdaklegergebed.
” ’Dule-gwensak wissulidgi ibmar-isgana-dulegi-danikid ebusale, we-dule, swilidiksuli gunonikoed. Geb sorba, deyob ibmar-imaksaye-wisgunonikile, we-dule, nue-nosadga gunonikoed.

” ’Dule-gwensak, ibmar-nued-imakega, ibmar-isgana-imakegardibe, ibmar-ise-sogar-sogleged, nue-binsassuli sogsadibe, geb degine, sorba, magar itononikile, ede, deyob sogewilubsulinye, we-dule, nue-nosadga gunonikoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak we-ibmarmar-soggwenadgi isgusale, e-isgusad dukin na barsogergebed.
Geb Bab-Jehováʼga na e-isgusad-anar sibad-wawaad-ome, sibad-omedibe, oburgwega ukoed. Weyobi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, Bab-Dummad we-dulega-isgusad-osulogega imakoed.’ ”
Dule-wileged e-ibmar-ukoed

Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Dule-isgusad sibad-wawaad-mimmi-bakega mani galakuele, sapur-nuu-gwabo, wagnuu-mimmi-gwabodibe, na e-isgusad-ular Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. Nuu-gwagwen e-isgusad-ular oburgwelegega ukoed, baiddi, ogumaklegega ukoed.
We-dule, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse we-nuumar sedoed. We-Bab-Dummadse-goled gebedgine isgusad-ular nuu-gwagwen weyob ukoed: E-dukar obipirmakoed, degi-inigwele, e-nono dukargi ungosulid.

Geb sorbali, isgued-ular nuu-uklenaid-e-abe ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-dikargi bomi-bomi imakoed. Geb nuu-abe-obichadi, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-nagagi mioed. We-ibmar-uklegedi isgued-ular ibmar-uklegedid.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled nuu-baiddi igar-maidba ogumakar ukoed. Weyobi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, Bab-Dummad we-dulega-isgusad-osulogega imakoed. Geb Bab-Dummad dule egi nossuliyob dakoed.

” ’Ar dule-isgusad sapur-nuu-gwabo-bakega, wagnuu-mimmi-gwabo-bakegardibe, mani galakubalile, madubur-bur-nued nibiratar na e-isgusad-ular Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. We-maduburgi, olivo-gwallu, degi, ina-wawadikid eogosulid. Ar we-madubur isgued-ular ibmar-uklegedid.

Geb we-madubur dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse sedoed. Bab-Jehová bemarga bela we-ibmar-ukmaid be ebinsamalaga, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled madubur na argan-nukgwen suoed. Geb we-madubur Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-bamalad-soogi-ogumakar-uklegedba-mesa ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ogumakoed. We-ibmar-uklegedi, isgued-ular ibmar-uklegedid.

Weyobi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled ibmar-ukleged Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. Adi, Bab-Jehová, dulega e-isgusad eliega, egi nossuliyob dakegar. Ibmar-ukleged-gwabgusaddi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledgadga guoed. Ar igi ibmar-gwag-ukleged obichale, a-dulemarga ukledae, deyob uklemogoed.’ ”
Dule-isgusad-ular ibmar-ukleged
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakdebalid, ega sogded: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo:

‘Dule-gwensak na wissulidba Bab-Jehová-ibmar-islidikidgi isgusale, Bab-Jehováʼga e-isgued-ular sibad-wawaad-machered-swilidikid, gwen boni-nikasulid ukoed. We sibad-wawaad-macheredga e-mani-gargegued mani-aidikuedba nasiklegoed. Ar igi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi mani-aidikued-wilub-ebislege, deyob ebislegoed. We-ibmar-uklegedi, isgued-ular ibmar-uklegedid.

Dule-isgusad we-ibmar-islidikidgi-isgusad-ulale, gannar a-wilub ibmar ukoed, degine, napi ibmar-atargi gwensak ukbaloed. We-ibmardi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga ukoed. Weyobi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled dule-isgusad-ular Bab-Dummadga sibad-wawaad-machered oburgoed, geb Bab-Dummad dule egi nossuliyob dakoed.
” ’Ar dule-gwensak na wissulidba Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidgi annanonikile, amba we-dule isgusye soglegoed, sabsur-odurdaklegergebed.

Degisoggu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse sibad-wawaad-machered-swilidikid, gwen boni-nikasulid sedoed. We sibad-wawaad-macheredga dule-isgusadba mani-soglesadba e-mani-gargegued nasiklegoed. Weyobi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled we-dule ibmar-wissulidba-isgusad Bab-Dummad ega osulogega imakoed, geb Bab-Dummad dule egi nossuliyob dakoed.
We-ibmar-uklegedi, isgued-ular ibmar-uklegedid. Ar we-dule, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Maidgi annasad, Bab-Jehováʼgi nue-dummad nosad.’ ”
